claims.evidence: Raw names ..._CKlein_<CTR|HSP><n> (experiment 1) and ..._CKlein2_<CTR|HSP><n> (experiment 2); MaxQuant experiments CTR_1-6 / HSP27_1-6. Supp: "two independent experiments were carried out, each with three independent pulldowns for both HSP27 and control".

Supp "Interactome analysis of HSP27": "HEK293T cells expressing either pRRL or HSP27FLAG were lysed ... incubated with anti-FLAG M2 agarose beads". Paper Fig 6F legend: "mitochondrial interactome of HSP27 (n = 6) versus control (non-bait) (n = 6)". Data: HSPB1 intensity 3.8-6.3e11 in HSP27 IPs vs 2.7e7-2.3e9 in controls.

claims.value: biological replicate = experiment (1, 2); technical replicate = pulldown 1-3
claims.evidence: Paper Fig 6F: "commonly identified in 2 biological replicates"; supp: two independent experiments, each with three independent pulldowns. Run file CKlein -> experiment 1, CKlein2 -> experiment 2 (MaxQuant CTR_1-3/HSP27_1-3 vs CTR_4-6/HSP27_4-6).
summary.txt: Multiplicity 1, no labels; proteinGroups has LFQ intensity columns. The PRIDE project-level quantification "SILAC" applies to the pulse-SILAC part only.

limitations: Control IP definition conflicts between sources: supp methods say control = HEK293T cells expressing empty pRRL vector + anti-FLAG IP; the supp statistics paragraph says "control (GFP) antibody"; the paper says "control (non-bait)". Encoded as "no bait (control FLAG IP)" without naming the vector or antibody.

Compartment not asserted: the paper calls this a "mitochondrial interactome" of "mitochondria lysates", the supp methods lyse whole HEK293T cells in a digitonin "mitochondrial IP buffer"; no cellular component column is written.

Whether the three pulldowns per experiment came from one lysate is not stated; they are encoded as technical replicates 1-3 of the experiment (biological replicate 1 or 2) following the paper's "2 biological replicates".
comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available (not recorded in parameters.txt; see SILAC part); convert-openms exits 1 for that reason.
ancestry, age, individual, passage number, cell type, storage temperature = not available (Cellosaurus has no population/age in years for HEK293T).
